Hi {name},

Open this link to verify your email address (valid for 24 hours):
{url}

reset.subject: Aysly: reset your password
reset.body:
Hi {name},

Open this link to reset your password (valid for 30 minutes, single use):
{url}

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email; your password won't change.

passwordChanged.subject: Aysly: your password was changed
passwordChanged.body:
Hi {name},

The password for your Aysly account was just changed and your sessions on other devices were signed out.

If you didn't make this change, reset your password right away with "Forgot password".
